projects.title: HydroSight
projects.description: Maps live FortyGuard thermal conditions across AI sites, then models water and carbon for a workload and ranks cooler / less water-intensive site × hour windows — with honest LIVE / last-TCM / ASSUMED provenance labels.

projects.title: TouchStone (Kasauti)
projects.highlight: A/B lab for food delivery & fintech · ship-or-stop decisions
projects.description: Production-style experimentation workstation: generate synthetic A/B datasets, run statistical evaluation (z-tests, CIs, effect sizes), inspect decision-ready charts, and export a Product Analytics-style memo.

projects.title: FraudLab
projects.highlight: Evidence before automation · ALLOW / REVIEW / BLOCK
projects.description: Demo workstation that builds synthetic payment data, scores fraud risk with an explainable EBM model, and applies clear policy rules — every decision ships with feature-level evidence.

projects.title: TabNet vs Tabular Baselines
projects.description: Study project comparing TabNet (standard and class-weighted) against Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost on the Telco Customer Churn dataset, with focus on class imbalance and feature-level explanations.

projects.title: RAG Research Assistant
projects.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline that answers questions from a PDF research corpus using Sentence-Transformers embeddings, FAISS vector search, and Groq LLM inference — answers constrained to retrieved context.

projects.title: Parse Your Resume
projects.highlight: ATS scoring · candidate ranking · live demo
projects.description: AI-powered resume parser with multi-engine PDF extraction, hybrid rule + Groq LLM parsing, role-aware ATS scoring, and a ranked candidate dashboard — FastAPI on Hugging Face Spaces, frontend on Vercel, Neon PostgreSQL.

projects.title: Parallel Genetic Algorithm for Feature Selection
projects.description: Evolutionary feature selection with DEAP and Python multiprocessing. Benchmarked sequential vs parallel GA on the Digits dataset (64 features).

projects.title: CLIO — Video Recommendation System
projects.highlight: Capstone accessible component · ALS · Flask + Next.js
projects.description: Independently accessible piece of the CLIO capstone: collaborative filtering with ALS, Flask rankings API, and a Next.js UI for feedback. The full advertising platform (incl. text-to-video) was an academic demo — not a live hosted product.

projects.title: Pakistan Mutual Fund Intelligence Platform
projects.description: Analyse, compare, and forecast mutual fund performance using ML and macroeconomic indicators — NAV history, MUFAP data, PSX signals, and 5-year NAV forecasts.
